title: A chapter's address shows its Space page, not Coming soon (LIVE-1289)

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-22: "The subdomain isn't a white label site. It's a Space page for the sub group."

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-22. encinitas.thegrouplocal.com showed a Coming soon website because the chapter had not published one. A chapter's address now sends the visitor to the chapter's Space page on Frequency (redirectChapterToSpacePage, a 307) until the chapter publishes a website of its own, in which case the website is served. Attaching a chapter no longer publishes anything: it only attaches the address (startChapterSite).

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const h=fs.readFileSync('lib/sites/hosted.ts','utf8');const p=fs.readFileSync('app/hosted/[host]/page.tsx','utf8');const bad=[];if(!h.includes('redirectChapterToSpacePage'))bad.push('the redirect is gone');if(!p.includes('redirectChapterToSpacePage'))bad.push('the home route no longer calls it');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1289: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when a chapter address stops sending the visitor to its Space page.
